findings.title: Cast bar keeps a stale primary-icon anchor after the icon grid empties
findings.evidence: 'if payload.primaryIcon ~= nil then inst.lastGridLayout.primaryIcon = payload.primaryIcon end' treats nil (real 'no primary icon' from an empty grid, IconGrid.lua:495) as 'field absent', so the cache keeps a pooled button that was ClearAllPoints()ed and Hide()n; resolveGridFrame fallback never reached. On default anchorMode PRIMARY, the cast bar likely disappears until an icon returns or /reload (unverified in client). Reached by disabling/removing every spell or swapping to a spec with no learned spell. No test covers Castbar:OnGridLayout.
findings.remediation: Copy primaryIcon unconditionally (including nil) into lastGridLayout; add a characterization test over Castbar:OnGridLayout that an empty grid falls back to resolveGridFrame. Owner smoke check in client.

findings.title: Cast-bar name truncation counts bytes, not characters
findings.evidence: 'if #name <= maxChars ... string.sub(name, 1, maxChars) .. "…"' under a label 'Truncate after (characters)'. Accented names cut early on deDE/frFR/esES/ptBR; ruRU at ~half, koKR/zhCN/zhTW at ~a third; cut mid-sequence yields invalid UTF-8. Opt-in (default 0); secret names skip truncation. MultiMeters already has a private utf8Truncate.
findings.remediation: Decision needed: Option A, an additive LibKa0s-Core Utf8Prefix helper (preferred if this cycle ships a LibKa0s release; MultiMeters can adopt it too), with a library-absent arm in the degraded stub; or Option B, a file-local utf8Prefix counting lead bytes. Update the stale comment at :332-333. Tests: TruncateName('Éclair de givre', 3) == 'Écl…', valid UTF-8, plus a CJK case; badge and inventory move in the same commit.

findings.title: Unknown /kcd debug word toggles the debug console
findings.evidence: After refuse(... 'unknown subcommand' ...) the code calls runDebug(self, ""), re-entering the bare branch which calls self.DebugLog:Toggle(). A typo like '/kcd debug spels' opens/closes the console. tests/test_slash.lua:198-199 works around it ('the reprint toggled the console; toggle it back') instead of pinning it.
findings.remediation: Reprint the sub-verb list after a refusal without toggling the console (split the list printer from the bare-verb toggle); replace the test workaround with a case asserting the console state is unchanged.

findings.title: /kcd debug castbar and /kcd debug interrupt can only show the target
findings.evidence: castbar verb calls m:DebugDump() with no unit; interrupt verb hard-codes NS.Compat.DebugInterrupt("target"). Both callees take a unit. Focus is a first-class tracked unit. /kcd diagnostics covers both units, so a workaround exists.
findings.remediation: Optional: accept an optional unit argument (target|focus) on both verbs and pass it through. Shares a function with F-003. Won't-fix is defensible given diagnostics coverage.

findings.title: Glow gate ignores casts by a non-attackable target while the target_casting trigger counts them
findings.evidence: Gate keyed on IsHostileUnitCasting (false when UnitCanAttack is false) and resolveInterruptible returns early when neither moved; target_casting trigger uses inst.isCasting() (any cast). For a friendly/non-attackable caster the tuple stays (false, nil), so RefreshAllGlows never calls UpdateGlow; glow off at start, stale at end. Default trigger is 'never'.
findings.remediation: Optional: owner decides whether target_casting means any cast or a hostile cast. If hostile, fix the trigger; if any, include the raw casting state in the gate tuple.

findings.title: CONFIG_CHANGED{general} rebuilds Cooldowns on scale/alpha slider ticks and grid drags
findings.evidence: Cooldowns rebuilds on section 'general', fired by the whole Master-controls block (scale, alpha, lock, visibility, debug console, minimap) and by grid drag-stop. No general row changes what Cooldowns polls; 'enabled' already reaches it through the stand-down latch and Resume rebuilds. Every throttled tick pays a full re-poll and SPELL_STATE fan-out. Unmeasured; config-time only.
findings.remediation: Optional, low value: narrow the condition to section == 'spells', with a characterization case proving 'enabled' still rebuilds via Resume.

findings.title: New default spell lists never reach existing profiles
findings.evidence: Seed is all-or-nothing on profile.spells being empty, not per (class, spec) pair; a nil pair can only mean never seeded, so seeding missing pairs could not overwrite intent. A spec added to defaults/Spells.lua later would give existing profiles an empty grid silently. Nobody affected today: every shipped spec has been in the defaults since 1.0.0.
findings.remediation: Defer. Re-check trigger: the first spec added to defaults/Spells.lua after 1.4.0; then seed missing (class, spec) pairs individually.
